Name: HP Bar
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/i574s8ahlseu665/hpbar.PNG[/img]﻿
This mod simply adds a green-red health bar under all monsters(except Pam ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) )
[size=4]
Multiplayer information:[/size]
- The mod needs to be installed for every player that wants to see the HP Bar. The host is not required to install the mod. The clients are not required to install the mod if the host has installed.

[size=4]Installation instructions:[/size]
1. (Install SMAPI if you haven't already)
2. Extract the zip file
3. Drag the HPBar folder into your Mods directory
4. Launch the game
[size=4]
Configuration:[/size]
- Open the config.json inside of the HPBar folder
- WidthScale and HeightScale allows you to change the size of the health bar
- RenderMode can be set to 1, 2 or 3:
  1: Show only visual bar
  2: Show only number e.g. 55/64
  3: Show visual bar and number
